description: The blast-radius dimensions a plan-tier classifier answers (plan-preflight design D3). Each is a narrow typed question; the shim combines the answers, and a verdict may only raise the tier. Overridable per project under loop.plan-preflight.dimensions.

dimensions.question: How likely is it that this plan changes an authentication, authorization or security path?
How likely is it that this plan changes persisted data or its format?
How likely is it that this plan changes an interface other code or other systems call or read?
How likely is it that this plan performs or enables an operation that cannot be undone?
Taken as a whole, does this plan need the light review (one read of the plan against the code) or the full one (every lens, a preflight test author and its review)?
